core.title: 3-1/2 Inch Narrow Delano Cabinet Pull, Laurey 25426

text.description_html:
Laurey 25426, 64mm Narrow Delano Pull

Easy to care for and oh so stylish, the 3-1/2 Inch Narrow Delano Cabinet Pull is the ideal cabinet hardware for your remodel. This affordable cabinet pull is sleek and is available in polished chrome finish. The 64mm Narrow Delano Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Delano Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Delano Narrow Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 2-1/2"
  • Overall Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 1/8"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
  • Finish: Polished Chrome

Sold Individually
